desc:
One bottle. One shooter. Everyone else hides. [GAME IS IN BETA STAGE, EXPECT BUGS!]

The bottle spins in the middle of the circle. Whoever it lands on becomes the shooter. Everyone else gets 10 seconds to scatter and find a spot before the hunt begins.

- Realistic gunplay: heavy recoil, full-auto spray control and headshots!
- Pistols, machine pistols, hand cannons and throwables, each with its own feel!
- Hide, crawl and run through all types of maps!
- Spend tokens at the lobby vendor to sabotage the hunt!
- Gunsmith: sights, grips, lights and more for each weapon!
- Unlock gun skins, kill effects and emotes from cases!
- Daily rewards, daily challenges and levels!

HIDE AND SEEK / SHOOTER 
[SUPPORTS PC, CONSOLE, MOBILE]

CONTROLS
PC: C - Crouch | Z - Crawl | Q - Dash | Ctrl - Shift Lock | Y - Inspect | C - Slide (WHILE RUNNING)
Controller: R3 - Crouch | L1 - Crawl | B - Dash | Y - Slide | Select - Menu | D-Pad Right - Inspect

Ideas or bugs? Drop them in the mailbox in the lobby.
